name: sendsets
description: Cold email for AI agents: connect and inspect sending mailboxes and warmup, build and launch outbound campaigns, add leads, and read and answer replies. Hosted server with OAuth 2.1; send actions go through an approval policy.

examples.title: Check senders
examples.description: Inspect connected mailboxes and their warmup
examples.prompt: Show me my connected mailboxes and how their warmup is going.

examples.title: Draft a campaign
examples.description: Build an outbound sequence without sending
examples.prompt: Create a draft campaign called Founder outreach with a three-step sequence for SaaS founders. Don't start it.

examples.title: Handle replies
examples.description: Find replies and draft a response
examples.prompt: Which leads in my latest campaign replied? Draft a response to the newest reply.
